title: The Accessibility Project
summary: On Friday evening, February 20, 2015, the nine-person Bennett Hall family gathers around the basement drafting table to build their ENGL 102 proposal: The Accessibility Project—replacing CPI's unreadable, non-WCAG/Section 508 PDF maps with a compliant digital and print blueprint documenting every curb ramp, automatic door, push-button door, accessible restroom, and 24/7 OEA Poly Pass hillside elevator pass-through.

scenes.title: A Student and a Man: Mapping the Unseen Campus
